title: same after ||
notes: `same` continues a chain joined by `&&`; after `||` it is refused (zega#86).

knownFailure.reason: zegadb/zega#86: the pinned engine (2b5ebd2) has no has/!have/in/with/same chains or N hops; this case records its outcome until the pin moves.

observed.stderr:
error: expected a comparison after has
  schema:142:15
    Airport(has route(code = "NRT") || same route in country) { code }
                ^^^^^
  help: use `=`, `!=`, `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`, `<>`, `findExact`, `findLike`, `startsExact`, `startsLike`, `endsExact`, or `endsLike`
